_note: Published smFRET state populations for GPCR benchmark proteins. Used as ground-truth lambda_fret signal in CryoEnsemble multi-modal posterior.

a2a.conditions: purified in detergent micelles, 37C, no ligand (apo)

dye_pairs.label: ICL3-ECL2 (intracellular/extracellular gate)
dye_pairs.note: Active state fraction increases 0.32→0.61 upon NECA agonist addition

a2a.key_finding: Apo A2A samples active-like state at 32% population in solution; cryo-EM datasets are typically 100% inactive because antagonist-stabilized forms are used for structure determination

beta2ar.conditions: purified in lipid nanodiscs, 25C, no ligand (apo)

dye_pairs.label: TM6-TM3 (canonical activation sensor)
dye_pairs.note: Active fraction rises 0.29→0.85 upon full agonist + G-protein

beta2ar.key_finding: Beta2AR apo samples active-like state at 29% in nanodiscs; EMPIAR-10258 particles are ~100% inactive (carazolol inverse agonist used for cryo-EM)

mu_opioid.reference: Huang et al., Nature 2015 + Sounier et al., Nature 2015

dye_pairs.label: TM5-TM6 distance
dye_pairs.note: Morphine partially shifts toward active (0.20→0.45); DAMGO full agonist 0.20→0.70

mu_opioid.key_finding: Apo mu-OR samples 20% active-like; cryo-EM structures (4DKL, 5C1M) capture only inactive

_validation_target.description: CryoEnsemble posterior should assign population weights matching smFRET fractions within 2x sem for each state
_validation_target.primary_metric: R2 between predicted posterior weights and smFRET population fractions
_validation_target.target: R2 >= 0.70 across all dye pairs and conditions
_validation_target.baseline: cryoDRGN assigns 0% weight to active states (reconstruction floor); smFRET shows 20-32% active in apo conditions
